spans.s: इष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Sought, wished for; 2. agreeable (as in इष्टगन्ध); 3. respected (as in इष्टदेवता).
इष्ट (II) m. A lover, a husband.
इष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Sought, wished for; 2. agreeable (as in इष्टगन्ध); 3. respected (as in इष्टदेवता).
इष्ट-आपत्ति f. a statement by a debater or controversialist which is favourable to his antagonist also, e.g. ‘इष्टापत्तौ दोषान्तरमाह.’
इष्टापूर्त n. sacrificing and charities, इष्टापूर्तविधेः स्पत्नशमनात् &c. Mv.iii.
इष्टका-पथ m. a road made of bricks.
इष्टका-न्यास m. laying the foundation of a house.
इष्टम् ind. To one’s fill or satisfaction.

इष्टि f. 1. Sacrificing, sacrifice; 2. wish, desire (in this sense the word is used by Patanjali in his Bhāshya to indicate his desire that any particular form, though not sanctioned by Pāṇini, should be considered as correct; Cf. उपसंख्यान.); 3. any desired object; 4. oblation consisting of butter &c.; 5. impulse, hurry; 6. invitation.
इष्टि-पशु m. an animal intended to be killed at a sacrifice.
